operator: H[f,i]=C[f,i] Pc; C[f,i]=-i (E_i-E_f) O[f,i]/(2 m_N c^2 M_4 c^2); O=sum sigma_j cross (pi_j c), m_N c^2=938.92 MeV, M_4 c^2=4 m_N c^2 in equal-mass projection
coefficient_semantics: Signed complex Cartesian amplitude per Pc in one nuclear phase convention; reverse is its conjugate. An exact zero is not an estimate. Null indicates unavailable, not zero. No proxy is a material coupling.
energy_reference: 4He ground state, excitation energies in MeV

alpha_20p21.status: TUNL evaluated broad resonance below DD threshold; distinct from threshold-pole candidate

dd_0plus_pole.status: Czerski arXiv:2409.02112v3 inferred near-threshold pole, E_R->0 working convention; not a discrete state or an independently fixed pole energy/width

dd_s0.status: D+D continuum L=0 S=0; illustrative E_cm=0.25–2.5 keV range, not mean or bin

dd_s2.status: D+D continuum L=0 S=2; illustrative E_cm=0.25–2.5 keV range, not mean or bin

dd_p1.status: D+D continuum L=1 S=1 J=1 (also J=0,2, not reached from alpha_gs by Eq.27); no discrete g

alpha_23p64.status: TUNL evaluated broad resonance; excluded in isospin symmetry; Coulomb mixing may relax isospin, not rank/parity

alpha_24p25.status: TUNL evaluated broad resonance, not a stable level; particle widths p=3.08, n=2.87, d=0.15 MeV

alpha_25p95.status: TUNL evaluated broad resonance; excluded in isospin symmetry

alpha_28p31.status: TUNL evaluated broad resonance, not a stable level

alpha_28p37.status: TUNL evaluated broad resonance, not a stable level

alpha_20p21.reason: equal parity and rank 1 cannot connect J=0 to J=0

dd_0plus_pole.reason: equal parity and rank 1 cannot connect J=0 to J=0

dd_s0.reason: equal parity and rank 1 cannot connect J=0 to J=0; holds for each energy and any packet

dd_s2.reason: equal parity and rank 1 cannot connect J=2 to J=0; holds for each energy and any packet

dd_p1.reason: allowed by J/parity/T, but no microscopic multichannel Coulomb-normalized DD transition; linear amplitude retains scattering phase

alpha_20p21.branching: On-shell 20.21 MeV: p+t open, n+3He closed. Reaching the real level from the DD threshold requires removal of about 3.64 MeV before its decay. An intermediate evaluated at DD energy does not inherit this on-shell branch closure.

dd_0plus_pole.branching: Both p+t and n+3He are open near the DD threshold. The model partial proton width and IPC interpretation do not fix the neutron residue or a p/n yield ratio.

higher_order.reason: The first path generated by Eq.27 between even states takes two insertions through 1- (T=0 in the isospin limit). Two insertions alone are frame-dependent; the physical same-order contact/transformation terms, odd continuum amplitudes and energy-conserving lattice spectrum are not supplied.

physical_odd_continuum.normalization: delta(E-E') with E in eV; multiply by sqrt(dE) only for a declared bin/packet under a fixed phase and smooth-amplitude approximation, not a material spin coefficient
physical_odd_continuum.flux_conversion: requires a specified incoming partial wave, scattering boundary condition and incident current/density; no such physical flux coefficient supplied

momentum.normalization: Sum over atoms |e_a|^2=1 (mass weighted), Pc_pair_0to1= i sqrt(hbar omega/2) sum_over_pair sqrt(m_a c^2) e_a, and reverse is its complex conjugate. Harmonic +i convention for p=i p0(a†-a). Multiply by C exactly once; no independent 1/sqrt(N) on an already normalized mode and no independent penetrability on Coulomb-dressed amplitude.

optical_37meV_two_mass_reference.status: measured energy scale, two-mass Gamma eigenvector model, full loading; not a measured foil mode shape
optical_37meV_two_mass_reference.beam_pair_one_moving_target_abs_Pc_eV: same as one D; incident beam particle not assigned lattice mode momentum
optical_37meV_two_mass_reference.two_distinct_D_in_phase_abs_Pc_eV: 11671.246807203359/sqrt(N), N>=2; add signed D vectors first for arbitrary phase

pumped_PdD_archived.status: g9_edge prepared-state harmonic energy projected from g3_lattice; equivalent uniform coherent-mode amplitude is conditional, not measured foil occupation
pumped_PdD_archived.pumped_pair_rule: beam + one target takes one D; two co-moving targets double amplitudes; opposite phases can cancel; use actual mode eigenvector if supplied

isolated_particle_rms_not_mode.status: g10_quantum_site model, cubic one-component rms sqrt(2 m_D c2 <K>/3)

physical.nuclear_source_comparison: The evaluated level widths and branch thresholds in states and particle_exit_thresholds_MeV_from_alpha_ground apply to their named on-shell nuclear sources, not to the finite model states or as a physical odd denominator or model loss. The candidate 0+ pole widths are model-inferred; neither source is input to the additive 40 eV G12 readout.

standalone_odd_witness.source: coupling_results.json, intrinsic_witness Nmax=6 Coulomb_fixed_T=true, Jz=0, fixed T=0 EM500, one Cartesian component
standalone_odd_witness.final: lowest 1- basis eigenstate, not a DD entrance or a physical evaluated level

mode.extension_to_uniform_N_cells: divide each entry by sqrt(N_cells); sum the signed momenta of actual pair members before multiplication by g
mode.pair_members_in_mode: one moving D, other D has zero amplitude; Pd is not a reacting particle

standalone_even_path.source: coupling_results.json intrinsic_witness, first three odd rows and first two even columns in each marked basis; not a complete odd spectral sum
standalone_even_path.orientation: f=even0, i=even1, both Jz=0, fixed T=0; states are labelled by basis index only
standalone_even_path.kernel: K(x)=sum_r conj(C_z[r,f])*C_z[r,i]/(E_i-E_r+x+i0), all energies in eV; x is energy lost by the lattice at the first insertion. K has units eV^-1. Multiply by the corresponding ordered lattice Pc matrix elements, not by a width or an entrance penetrability.

archived_peak_as_single_classical_harmon.status: separate comparison, collinear one moving D at spatial RMS of archived site peak Pc, not a globally matched coherent state

evidence.provenance: The retained first-order and Coulomb-packet evidence has the original v1 input hash. The conditional second-order numbers use its stored signed matrix elements and levels; no refit, continuum matching or native rerun.
